title: Tax by borrower
status: Rates for tax year 2026-27 (April 2026 to March 2027), the first under the Income-tax Act, 2025. Public summaries say the Finance Act, 2026 kept the rates of FY 2025-26. Secondary sources only, not yet checked against the Act or the Finance Act: the official sites (incometaxindia.gov.in, incometax.gov.in, indiabudget.gov.in, egazette.gov.in) could not be opened from the session of 01-10-2026, and on 12-10-2026 (Q2) incometaxindia.gov.in refused this session (403 from its edge) and indiacode.nic.in timed out, so the rates stay as public summaries give them until the owner confirms them against the Act and the Finance Act, 2026. On 12-10-2026 the owner sent pages of the Act: they confirm the company's 22% (section 200(1)); section 202's table and section 156(2)'s conditions run on past the pages sent. Later years are taken at the same rates. Tax is worked out on profit before tax, nil on a loss, and not rounded to the nearest Rs. 10 as a return is. The borrower's CA confirms it; any other rate can be typed.

borrowers.label: Proprietor
borrowers.who: One person running the business in their own name
borrowers.law: Section 202 (the new tax regime; section 115BAC of the 1961 Act) and section 156 (the rebate; section 87A of the 1961 Act) of the Income-tax Act, 2025; marginal relief just above the rebate's limit and at each surcharge threshold
borrowers.source: cleartax.in and axismaxlife.com slab tables for FY 2026-27; bajajfinserv.in on Budget 2026 (slabs unchanged); aubsp.com and caclubindia.com on the section 156 rebate and its marginal relief; taxguru.in on section 202; cleartax.in on surcharge and marginal relief

borrowers.label: Partnership firm or LLP
borrowers.who: A partnership firm or a limited liability partnership
borrowers.law: Rates in force for firms and LLPs, with marginal relief on the surcharge
borrowers.source: taxmann.com and caalley.com rate charts for AY 2026-27; taxguru.in and taxscan.in on rates after the Finance Act, 2026

borrowers.label: Company
borrowers.who: A company on the concessional rate of section 115BAA
borrowers.law: Section 115BAA of the Income-tax Act, 1961; section 200 of the Income-tax Act, 2025
borrowers.source: The 22%: section 200(1) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 as amended by the Finance Act, 2026, read on the copy the owner sent on 12-10-2026. The surcharge and cess: taxmann.com and caalley.com rate charts for AY 2026-27, not yet checked against the Act
